tools.name: request_api_key
tools.description: Provision a prepaid ActionGate API key with $1.00 of starter credits for this operator email.

email.description: Operator email address that should own the API key.

tools.name: balance
tools.description: Return the current prepaid credit balance and usage count for an ActionGate API key.

tools.name: top_up
tools.description: Generate a Stripe Checkout link so the human operator can add prepaid credits to an existing ActionGate API key.

api_key.description: Existing ActionGate API key to top up.

tier.description: Credit pack tier. Defaults to starter.

tools.name: risk_score
tools.description: Score the risk of a proposed agent action before execution. Paid via x402 or API key credits. Free tier: 20 risk score calls/day per client.

request_id.description: Optional caller-supplied request identifier for tracing and receipts.

actor_id.description: Stable actor identifier for the agent or wallet operator.

wallet_address.description: Optional onchain wallet address associated with the acting agent.

actor.description: Actor metadata for the agent proposing the action.

action_type.description: The proposed action category, such as transfer, swap, or approve.

action.description: Action payload to evaluate. Additional action-specific fields are accepted as passthrough.

context.description: Optional execution context such as chain state, balances, or treasury metadata.
